_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for bank-notification parsing (HU-03 of
docs/requirements/fase-2/19-notificaciones-bancarias.md).
Read by BOTH engines: the Kotlin one that runs in production inside
NotificationListenerService, and the Dart mirror used by flutter test.
The ENGINE is duplicated, the RULES never are: a rule that exists on only
one side is a bug.
'validated': true means the rule was written against a REAL notification
captured from the issuer's app and is covered by a literal test case.
'validated': false means the format was INFERRED and nobody has seen it.
Today NO rule here is a guess: the three catalogued issuers are all
validated against real captured text.
'packageNameValidated' is a DIFFERENT claim and is tracked separately: it
says the package string was confirmed on a real device (adb shell pm list
packages).
BANCOLOMBIA IS NOT IN THIS CATALOG, and reintroducing it needs a fresh
decision, not just a rule. Bancolombia does not send push notifications,
only SMS. An SMS reaches NotificationListenerService as a notification of
the MESSAGING app, not of the bank, so capturing it would mean enabling
the listener over the messaging app and reading the TITLE (the sender) of
every message the user receives — one-time codes and personal
conversations included — just to decide which ones to process. That turns
the filter from 'by packageName, before reading anything' into 'by
sender, which requires reading first', breaking the non-negotiable rule
of HU-08 and inviting a Google Play rejection.
The package string is compared EXACTLY (Nequi capitalizes 'MobileApp',
Wallet is 'walletnfcrel' not 'wallet'): a typo here captures nothing and
raises no error, by design.
See assets/capture/README.md.
'target' declares WHICH part of the notification the regex runs against:
'title', 'text' (the body from EXTRA_TEXT/EXTRA_BIG_TEXT) or 'combined'
(title + '\n' + text). Nu splits amount (title) from counterparty (body),
Nequi puts the amount inside the body sentence and never in the title.

globalIgnoreRules.note: One-time passwords. Never parsed, never persisted, never shown.

globalIgnoreRules.match: (?:nunca (?:te )?(?:pediremos|pedimos)|no compartas tu clave|no compartas tus datos|alerta de seguridad|intento de (?:acceso|ingreso)|inicio de sesi[oó]n)
(?:recuerda (?:pagar|tu pago)|no olvides (?:pagar|tu pago|registrar)|pr[oó]xim[ao] a vencer|vence (?:hoy|ma[ñn]ana|el)|fecha l[ií]mite de pago)
globalIgnoreRules.note: The 'no olvides registrar' branch is validated by the real Google Wallet reminder: '¡No olvides registrar tus gastos!'.

globalIgnoreRules.match: (?:aprovecha|promoci[oó]n|felicitaciones|te preaprobamos|cr[eé]dito preaprobado|cupo preaprobado|descuento del|invita a tus amigos|gana con)

rules.note: Real: 'Recibiste 128.920,00 en tu cuenta' / 'Te llegó dinero de DANIELA TORO VALENCIA'. Amount has NO '$' here. merchant is a PERSON's name (third-party PII, see ParsedNotification docs).
Fallback when the body is missing or does not name the sender.
Real: 'Compra aprobada por $58.470,00' / 'Tu compra en TIENDA D1 SANTA ROSA H…'. Nu sends NO card last4.
Real: 'Enviaste $5.500,00' / 'Le enviaste a Aur*** Cri******* Sep*******…'. The counterparty arrives MASKED by Nu; it is stored exactly as received, never completed.

Real: title 'Te enviaron plata por Bre-B' (NO amount) / body 'Te enviaron $1. Entra a tu app y revisa tu saldo.'. target=text on purpose: the title repeats the verb without a figure. Nequi sends neither counterparty nor last4.
Real: title 'Envío de plata exitoso' / body 'Te contamos que el envío de plata por $1 fue exitoso...'. The amount sits MID-SENTENCE inside the body.
Real: 'Recordatorio de Wallet' / '¡No olvides registrar tus gastos!'. Wallet nags about bookkeeping; it is not a movement.

Real: title 'DROGUERIA LAS 24' / body '38.000,00 COP con Visa ••5615'. Wallet INVERTS Nu's layout: the TITLE is the merchant and the BODY carries amount + explicit currency + card network + last4. The body match is MANDATORY: without it the title of a reminder ('Recordatorio de Wallet') would become a merchant with no amount.
